76336-from-vermont-to-damascus.title: Scotland, And England
76336-from-vermont-to-damascus.creator: Unknown
76336-from-vermont-to-damascus.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The bleak, rugged winter of 1895 in Vermont, when Jack Frost held nightly carnivals and mercury was found in the lower regions, the snow was scurrying from hill-top to vale to find a resting place,--such environments caused the author of this little volume to dream of fairer skies and warmer climes.

arxiv-2206-08219.creator: Kapitanov Alexander kapitanovalexander@gmail.com, Kvanchiani Karina karinakvanciani@gmail.com, Nagaev Alexander sashanagaev1111@gmail.com, Kraynov Roman ranakraynov@gmail.com, Makhliarchuk Andrei helloworld106@gmail.com SaluteDevices, Russia
arxiv-2206-08219.description: Abstract This paper introduces an enormous dataset, HaGRID (HAnd Gesture Recognition Image Dataset), to build a hand gesture recognition (HGR) system concentrating on interaction with devices to manage them. That is why all 18 chosen gestures are endowed with the semiotic function and can be interpreted as a specific action.

arxiv-2402-03964.title: Almost Perfect Mutually Unbiased Bases that are Sparse
arxiv-2402-03964.creator: Ajeet Kumar, Subhamoy Maitra, Somjit Roy
arxiv-2402-03964.description: Abstract In dimension d d , Mutually Unbiased Bases (MUBs) are a collection of orthonormal bases over ℂ d \mathbb{C}^{d} such that for any two vectors v 1 , v 2 v_{1},v_{2} belonging to different bases, the dot or scalar product | ⟨ v 1 | v 2 ⟩ | = 1 d |\braket{v_{1}|v_{2}}|=\frac{1}{\sqrt{d}} .

arxiv-2407-09880.title: Inferior interfacial superconductivity in 1 UC FeSe/SrVO 3 /SrTiO 3 with screened interfacial electron-phonon coupling
arxiv-2407-09880.creator: Nan Guo, Xiaoyang Chen, Tianlun Yu, Yu Fan, Qinghua Zhang, Minyinan Lei, Xiaofeng Xu, Xuetao Zhu, Jiandong Guo, Lin Gu, Haichao Xu, Rui Peng, Donglai Feng
arxiv-2407-09880.description: Abstract Monolayer FeSe/TiO x and FeSe/FeO x interfaces exhibit significant superconductivity enhancement compared to bulk FeSe, with interfacial electron-phonon coupling (EPC) playing a crucial role. However, the reduced dimensionality in monolayer FeSe, which may drive superconducting fluctuations, complicates the understanding of the enhancement mechanisms.

arxiv-2503-03432.title: Light drag in an Optomechanical system
arxiv-2503-03432.creator: Hazrat Ali, Nadia Boutabba, Amjad Sohail
arxiv-2503-03432.description: Abstract Light dragging refers to the change in the path of light passing through a moving medium. This effect enables accurate detection of very slow speeds of light, which have prominent applications in state transfer, quantum gate operations, and quantum memory implementations.

arxiv-2512-07834.title: Voxify3D: Pixel Art Meets Volumetric Rendering
arxiv-2512-07834.creator: Yi-Chuan Huang Jiewen Chan Hao-Jen Chien Yu-Lun Liu National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University
arxiv-2512-07834.description: Abstract Voxel art is a distinctive stylization widely used in games and digital media, yet automated generation from 3D meshes remains challenging due to conflicting requirements of geometric abstraction, semantic preservation, and discrete color coherence. Existing methods either over-simplify geometry or fail to achieve the pixel-precise, palette-constrained aesthetics of voxel art.

pmc-11592584.creator: Junji Ito, Tsuneo Yamashiro, Hayato Tomita, Joichi Heianna, Sadayuki Murayama, Akihiro Nishie, Sam Payabvash
pmc-11592584.description: Simple SummaryIntra-arterial infusion chemotherapy is an effective therapeutic option for malignant head and neck tumors. Precise advanced information on the arteries supplying tumors enables us to achieve a good treatment effect; shorten the operation time; and minimize both radiation exposure and the use of contrast medium. Therefore, a preoperative assessment of patients is clinically important.

pmc-11647859.title: Health-related quality of life assessment in head and neck cancer: A systematic review of phase II and III clinical trials
pmc-11647859.creator: Daria Maria Filippini, Francesca Carosi, Olimpia Panepinto, Giacomo Neri, Elisabetta Nobili, Nastassja Tober, Raffaele Giusti, Massimo Di Maio
pmc-11647859.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundPatients with head and neck cancer (HNC) bear a significant load, due to both disease-related symptoms and to toxicities associated with treatments. Evaluating quality of life (QoL) is crucial to gauge the physical and psychological impact on these patients.

pmc-12576996.title: Factors related to quality of life in caregivers of children with autism spectrum disorder: emphasizing challenges in the context of Eastern China
pmc-12576996.creator: Xu Chen, Jiao Tong, Xue Wang, Lu Zhu, Yiting Tao, Haiyan Zhao, Changjiang Liu, Yu Wang, Cheng Zhao, Dongmei Yan
pmc-12576996.description: BackgroundCaregivers of children with autism spectrum disorder (ASD) encounter multiple challenges, increasing their risk of experiencing a low quality of life (QOL). Therefore, this study aims to examine the QOL among caregivers of children with ASD in eastern China and to identify the associated factors across many aspects.

pmc-12699165.title: Elucidating the Role of NaCl in the on‐Surface Synthesis of Conjugated Azaacene Polymers on Au(111)
pmc-12699165.creator: Tim Kratky, Xunshan Liu, Sebastian Günther, Pingo Mutombo, Luca Schio, Luca Floreano, Silvio Decurtins, Jascha Repp, Pavel Jelínek, Shi‐Xia Liu, Laerte L Patera
pmc-12699165.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). On‐surface synthesis (OSS) offers unique opportunities for fabricating carbon‐based nanostructures that are unattainable by conventional wet‐chemical synthesis. Despite OSS being extremely successful, the use of coadsorbates to promote reactions remains largely unexplored. In this study, we investigate the role of sodium chloride (NaCl) in promoting the Scholl reaction (oxidative aryl–aryl coupling) of hexaazatriphenylene (HAT) molecules on Au(111), leading to the growth of conjugated azaacene oligomers.

pmc-13062696.title: Effects of warming on plant uptake of post‐fire nitrogen in an arctic heath tundra
pmc-13062696.creator: Wenyi Xu, Per Lennart Ambus
pmc-13062696.description: Summary Postfire nitrogen (N) becomes increasingly important with the rising frequency of fires in arctic tundra, and climate warming is expected to accelerate plant recovery following fire. However, how plants differ in utilizing this postfire N and how their postfire N uptake responds to warming remains unknown.

pmc-13239935.title: Impact of Low‐Dose Cranberry Polyphenols on Gut Microbiota and Circulating Polyphenol Metabolites in Overweight and Obese Individuals (A Randomized Double‐Blind Placebo‐Controlled Clinical Pilot Study)
pmc-13239935.creator: Maria Jocelyn Chicas Castellon, Min Ji Jang, Maritza Sirven Diaz, Md Ariful Haque, Stephen T. Talcott, Seockmo Ku, Susanne U. Mertens‐Talcott
pmc-13239935.description: Cranberry polyphenols reach the colon largely unmetabolized, where they interact with the gut microbiota to generate bioactive metabolites. However, few human studies have examined both the microbial and systemic metabolic responses to cranberry polyphenol intake, particularly in populations with metabolic risk. In this randomized, double‐blind, placebo‐controlled pilot study, 45 overweight or obese adults received either cranberry juice providing 54.

pmc-13384486.title: Intracellular sensing with transparent graphene-nanotube electrodes
pmc-13384486.creator: Xiao Fan, Jieun Park, Vaishali Malik, Lin Feng, Xin Zhang, Huilu Bao, Xiaoyu Zhang, Govindarajan Srimathveeravalli, Stephen S Nonnenmann, Jinglei Ping
pmc-13384486.description: Transparent electrodes based on graphene are ideal for multimodal cell sensing. However, the atomically flat basal plane of graphene limits the applications largely to capacitive detection of extracellular signals. Here, we develop a biocompatible graphene–carbon nanotube (CNT) hybrid (Bio-GCH), consisting of a graphene substrate covalently decorated with sparsely distributed CNT structures.

pmc-13385610.title: Trends and Disparities in Mortality from Malignant Parotid Gland Tumors in the United States, 1999-2023: A Population-Based Analysis
pmc-13385610.creator: Qianqian Xu, Sunjun Li, Fangyuan Liao, Donghao Lou, Tongbin Zhang
pmc-13385610.description: IntroductionMalignant parotid gland tumors account for less than 1% of all cancers yet represent a substantial proportion of head and neck malignancies. Long-term mortality trends and demographic disparities remain poorly defined. This study examined mortality trends and disparities across demographic and geographic subgroups in the United States.

pmc-13434156.title: Evaluation model for in-situ pyrolysis development potential of tar-rich coal based on fuzzy analysis, combined weighting, and grey-TOPSIS
pmc-13434156.creator: Kexin Che, Shijie Xiong, Jian Bai, Xin He, Wenfeng Wang
pmc-13434156.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). pmc-13492116.title: The evolution of a Na+-sensitive Vibrio cholerae mutant unmasks the moonlighting aminopeptidase PepA as a regulator of nhaB Na+/H+ antiporter gene expression
pmc-13492116.creator: Sebastian Herdan, Katharina Kohm, Robert Warneke, Florian Roth, Nadja Glaser, Lucia Villani, Nele Rüping, Lea Dreher, Nicolas Görge, Trung Duc Hoang, Emina Schunke, Claudia C. Häse, Juri Rappsilber, Günter Fritz, Fabian M. Commichau, Johannes Gibhardt, Julia Steuber
pmc-13492116.description: The pathogenic bacterium Vibrio cholerae is aquatic and can be cultivated in nutrient media with increased salt concentration. To maintain osmotic balance, V. cholerae uses Na+/H+ antiporters and a Na+-translocating NADH:quinone oxidoreductase (Na+-NQR). The exact contribution of the various Na+/H+ antiporters to maintaining Na+ and H+ homeostasis in V. cholerae is unclear.
